CAUSALITY LOCK: the character's emotional shift happens ONLY through his own face and posture — no external object appears, nothing about the laptop or desk changes.

SETTING (LOCKED, do not change): same home office desk scene as the reference image, three-quarter side camera angle. Navy blue desk, warm beige wall background, laptop open on the desk — the camera sees only the BACK of the laptop screen (its outer shell), never the display content, throughout the entire clip. Character wears the same plain teal sweater throughout. Flat 2D vector illustration style, simple clean linework, no photorealistic detail — this exact art style is preserved in every single frame, never drifting toward realism or 3D.

0 to 2 second: character's hand is still resting on his forehead, head bowed down looking toward the laptop, worried expression unchanged, completely still, matching the reference image exactly.

2 to 4 second: character slowly lowers his hand from his forehead down toward the desk, head still bowed, no change in expression yet.

4 to 6 second: character's head begins to lift slowly, eyes widening slightly, as if a thought is forming — expression shifts from worried toward curious, eyebrows raise slightly.

6 to 8 second: character's head is now upright, facing forward-ish (still three-quarter angle), eyes open wide, a small realization expression forming — mouth opens slightly as if about to speak, eyebrows raised.

8 to 9 second HOLD: character holds a clear expression of calm realization/relief — soft small smile, shoulders visibly relaxing down and back, sitting up straighter. Hold this exact pose and expression steady for a full second, no further movement.

STRICT NEGATIVE: no new objects appear anywhere in the frame. No hallucinated props, no phone, no pen, no cup, no second character, no hand gestures pointing at the laptop. The laptop screen display is NEVER shown to camera at any point — only the back of the screen is visible. The desk, wall, and laptop position never move or shift. The character's clothing color and style never change. No camera movement — camera stays completely static throughout, no pan, no zoom, no orbit. No text or UI elements appear on screen. No audio.
